name: first-atlas-workspace
description: First functional Atlas project — security knowledge base demo

source.title: Access Control Policy
statements: All production access requires multi-factor authentication.
Privileged actions must be audited and traceable.
Access grants expire after 90 days unless renewed.

source.title: Data Retention Policy
statements: Operational logs are retained for 365 days.
Customer data deletion requests must complete within 30 days.
Archived knowledge artifacts require explicit approval.

source.title: Atlas Platform Overview
source.summary: Atlas transforms knowledge into compiled, executable intelligence through a deterministic Kernel.
